settings.heading: Hand-Built Split Keyboards
settings.subtext: Hand-assembled split keyboards for developers. Built to order with open source firmware. Free shipping India-wide.

settings.title: Ergonomic by Design
settings.text: Your hands rest at natural shoulder width. No more hunching over a single keyboard slab. Columnar stagger aligns keys to your finger lengths.

settings.title: Fewer Keys, More Speed
settings.text: Thumb clusters and layers replace reaching for distant keys. Your fingers travel less, and every key is within one key of home row.

settings.title: Fully Programmable
settings.text: QMK/ZMK firmware lets you remap every key. Macros, layers, tap-dance, combos — your keyboard, your rules. Open source, forever.

settings.heading: Why Split Keyboards?
settings.subheading: Designed for developers who type 8+ hours a day

settings.title: Hand-Assembled
settings.text: Every keyboard is built by hand in our workshop. No mass production — just careful assembly, testing, and quality checks before shipping.

settings.title: ZMK & QMK, Out of the Box
settings.text: All our keyboards ship with ZMK or QMK firmware. Remap keys, build layers, flash macros — your layout, your rules. No vendor lock-in, ever.

settings.title: Made to Order, Not Off a Shelf
settings.text: We build your keyboard after you order it — hand-assembled, tested, and dispatched in 3–4 weeks. Free shipping anywhere in India.

settings.title: Built by hand, shipped with care.
